meta.name: skill-optimize
meta.description: Run a structured evaluate-analyze-improve cycle on any GAAI skill to measure quality, detect regressions, and propose targeted improvements. Activate when a skill needs baseline evaluation, after SKILL.md modifications, or when friction-retrospective flags a skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对任意技能运行评估改进循环
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要系统性地测量并提升技能质量
copy.tagline_en: Run an evaluate-analyze-improve cycle on any skill
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically measure and improve skill quality

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能对任何GAAI技能执行结构化的评估-分析-改进循环：先测量质量基线，检测修改前后的性能退化，然后提出针对性的改进建议，但修改必须由你审批，不会自动应用。
howto.when: 当你需要建立某个技能的质量基线、在修改SKILL.md后做回归检查、或摩擦回顾（friction-retrospective）标记某个技能时触发。

say.text: 帮我评估一下当前技能的质量基线。
say.note: Claude会创建评估文件并运行首次评测。

say.text: 对刚修改的SKILL.md做回归检查。
say.note: Claude会对比修改前后的分数变化。

say.text: 运行一次完整的评估-分析-改进循环。
say.note: Claude执行七步流程，最后输出改进提案等你审批。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude runs a structured evaluate-analyze-improve cycle on any GAAI skill: it measures quality baselines, detects regressions after modifications, and proposes targeted improvements. All SKILL.md changes require human approval.
howto.when_en: Activate when you need a baseline quality measurement for a skill, after SKILL.md modifications, or when friction-retrospective flags a skill.

say_en.text: Run a baseline evaluation on my skill.
say_en.note: Claude creates evals.yaml and runs the first iteration.

say_en.text: Check for regressions after SKILL.md edits.
say_en.note: Claude compares scores pre- and post-modification.
Claude executes all seven steps and presents a proposal for your approval.
